title: N-channel MOSFET H-bridge drive
goal: A reader must be able to trace the 24 V H-bridge, its motor terminals, gate-drive blocks, bootstrap capacitors, and return current shunt.

rubric.must: Four N-channel MOSFETs are visibly arranged as two high-side and two low-side switches between the 24 V rail and the return.
The DC motor is connected only across the two half-bridge midpoint nets OUTA and OUTB.
Both low-side MOSFET sources join at a current-sense shunt before reaching ground.
Separate left and right IR2104 gate-driver blocks have visible high-side and low-side gate connections.
A 100 nF bootstrap capacitor is shown from BOOT to the switching midpoint on each leg.
The 470 µF bulk capacitor is visibly across the 24 V supply and ground.
MOSFETs read IRLZ44N and the shunt reads 10 mΩ, 3 W.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Q1/Q3 high side off VBUS, Q2/Q4 low side down to SENSE, motor across OUTA/OUTB, shunt from SENSE to GND, a gate driver per leg with its bootstrap capacitor from BOOT to SW.
